# fail a fresh-interpreter `import <module>` (verified import-order
# dependencies / missing optional deps). A module listed here is a
# known, intentional exception; a NET-NEW failure fails the gate.

# Key: module name (drift-proof). Stale entries (listed but importing
# fine) are reported but do not fail — re-run --write-baseline after
